items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Archie Bleyer was instrumental in this of the chords and deals... I remember one of his stocks called Business in F.

ctx.x: Right. I was just thinking, when I first started playing stocks they were always written out.

Yeah. Now, Archie Bleyer was instrumental in this of the chords and deals, you know. So I think during that era -- now, we would have to check when Archie Bleyer and his -- I remember one of his stocks called Business in F. Did you ever play that?
